content:
alex (AE): FYI — GreenWave wants to sign POC but they're holding until we provide compliance docs: SOC 2 attestation (they asked for full PDF behind NDA), ISO27001 cert copy, pen-test attestation letter (signed + scope), sanitized network diagram, and staging IP block list. They also asked whether Dedicated is required for EU-only residency and what the incremental cost is for a 45-day trial. Need someone to own the package + presigned upload.

toni (SE): I can pull the tech bundle and do the Hosted vs Dedicated delta for a 45-day POC. Quick Q: we only release full SOC2 after NDA; can we share an attestation summary first? Also, do they want a presigned PUT or POST? POST is easier for multiple files.

helen (Security): Standard: SOC2 full PDF -> dataroom post-NDA. We can provide SOC2 attestation PDF and control mapping upfront. Pen-test: we provide a signed attestation letter that names scope (e.g., "inference API endpoints, admin console, and optional dedicated nodes if reserved") and the test date + 3rd-party vendor. Raw findings are not released without redaction and legal review. Network diagrams must be sanitized (no internal hostnames or customer IDs).

alex (AE): They prefer POST (they have multi-file uploads). Also asked whether Dedicated is mandatory for EU residency or if Hosted in eu-west region suffices for their regulators. Said finance needs a hard delta for decisioning.

toni (SE): Hosted in eu-west can meet data residency for most cases — Dedicated only required if customer mandates single-tenant hardware / contractual isolation. I'll prepare a cost delta: Hosted (pro-rate tokens + egress) vs Dedicated (pro-rated reserved + onboarding fee). ETA: same-day.

helen (Security): Note: if GreenWave insists on Dedicated being in-scope for the pen-test, that triggers an infra pen-test addendum and ~2-3 week extension. Also pen-test attestation requires an authorized security signer; legal must approve the exact wording before we publish. If they request CVE-level details we need redaction + legal sign-off.

vault-bot: Secure dataroom created: DR-9012. Presigned uploads enabled (POST and PUT supported). Access: alex, toni, helen.

toni (SE): I'll provision DR-9012 folder layout and generate a presigned POST form with 48h expiry and server-side SSE. Example command I often share:

curl -X POST "<PRESIGNED_POST_URL>" -F "key=uploads/greenwave/${filename}" -F "file=@diagram.png"

toni (SE): Checklist I'll drop in DR-9012: SOC2 attestation (pdf), ISO27001 cert (pdf), draft pen-test attestation (unsigned), sanitized network diagram template (png), staging CIDR placeholders (txt), and Hosted vs Dedicated delta (pdf). ETA: 4 hours.

alex (AE): Great. I'll ask GreenWave for the CISO name/title to sign NDA and pen-test acceptance and request their intended filenames and primary email for the upload. Also asking if they require customer-managed KMS during POC.

helen (Security): KMS: customer-managed keys supported only on Private deployments. If they need KMIP/HSM for POC that pushes to Private and needs legal + infra onboarding. Mention that to the customer early.

alex (AE): Copy. I'll confirm signer and KMS requirement. Thanks team — will update when NDA signed. :white_check_mark:
